mapper.sql: SELECT `dev`.`id`, `dev`.`device_name`, `dev`.`device_code`, `dev`.`device_state`, `dev`.`communication_time`, `dev`.`department_id`, `dev`.`department_name`, `dev`.`area_last_id`, `dev`.`area_name`, `devp`.`install_date`, `devp`.`purchase_date`, `iot_prod_info`.`prod_brand_name`, `iot_prod_info`.`prod_category_code`, `iot_prod_info`.`prod_category_name`, `iot_prod_info`.`id` AS `prod_id`, `iot_prod_info`.`prod_name`, `iot_prod_info`.`prod_model_name` FROM `center_biz_device` `dev` LEFT JOIN `center_biz_device_expand` `devp` ON `dev`.`id` = `devp`.`id` LEFT JOIN `iot_prod_view` `iot_prod_info` ON `dev`.`device_iot_prod_id` = `iot_prod_info`.`id` LEFT JOIN `center_biz_tag_ref` `tag_ref` ON `tag_ref`.`business_key` = `dev`.`id`
mapper.select:
SELECT `c`.`category_name` AS `genreName`, COUNT(1) AS `num` FROM `center_biz_device` `dev` INNER JOIN `iot_prod_view` `b` ON `dev`.`device_iot_prod_id` = `b`.`id` AND `b`.`tenant` = #{tenant} AND `b`.`deleted` = 0 INNER JOIN `iot_category_view` `c` ON `b`.`prod_category_code` = `c`.`category_code` AND `c`.`tenant` = #{tenant} AND `b`.`deleted` = 0 INNER JOIN `center_biz_tag_ref` `tag_ref` ON `tag_ref`.`business_key` = `dev`.`id`
`tag_ref`.`tag_id` = #{tagId}
AND `dev`.`area_id` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{areaId}, '%')
GROUP BY `c`.`category_name`
